description:
Reid Kielder 2 | Carbon fork gravel bike
Lightweight, versatile and built for adventure – the ideal gravel bike for exploring off-road trails, tackling challenging climbs and discovering new routes from road to bridleway.
The Reid Bikes Kielder 2 is designed for riders ready to take their gravel adventures further, combining a lightweight aluminium frame with a full carbon fork and an upgraded Microshift Sword drivetrain. Offering an impressive balance of performance, capability and value, it's a versatile choice for everything from fast road rides to gravel exploration, towpaths and bikepacking adventures.
Its custom aluminium frame features a carefully designed tubeset and gravel-focused geometry to deliver a confident, comfortable riding position across mixed terrain. A full carbon fork helps reduce weight at the front of the bike, while internal cable routing through the headset creates a clean, streamlined finish. With generous mounting options, the Reid Bikes Kielder 2 is also ready to be customised for commuting, carrying equipment and longer adventures.
A Microshift Sword Black 1x drivetrain combines a 42T chainring with a wide-range 11–46T cassette, delivering straightforward shifting and plenty of gearing flexibility. The wide cassette makes steep climbs more manageable while retaining the higher gears needed for faster riding on flatter sections and descents. The single-chainring setup also simplifies gear changes, making it a practical choice for varied gravel routes.
Tektro MD-C550 mechanical disc brakes provide reliable, controlled stopping power, with a dual-piston design that helps deliver smooth and consistent braking performance. CST Overton tyres offer a versatile balance of efficient rolling on tarmac and grip on gravel tracks, towpaths and other mixed surfaces, making the Kielder 2 equally capable on road and off-road adventures.
With its carbon fork, upgraded drivetrain and practical frame design, the Reid Kielder 2 delivers an impressive specification for riders looking to progress their gravel riding without paying premium prices. Whether you're tackling demanding climbs, exploring remote trails or adding adventure to your daily commute, it's built to help you ride further with confidence.
The Reid Bikes Kielder 2 is ideal for:

Gravel riding and off-road exploration, with gravel-focused geometry for confident handling across mixed terrain

Riders upgrading their gravel setup, with a lightweight aluminium frame and full carbon fork for a capable, performance-focused ride

Tackling steep climbs and fast descents, with Microshift Sword Black gearing and a wide-range 11–46T cassette

Simple, versatile gear changes, with a 1x drivetrain featuring a 42T chainring for straightforward shifting across varied terrain

Road and trail riding, with CST Overton tyres designed to roll efficiently on tarmac while providing grip on gravel and towpaths

Confident everyday braking, with Tektro MD-C550 mechanical disc brakes featuring a dual-piston design

Commuting and longer adventures, with multiple mounting options for accessories and equipment

A clean, premium finish, with internal headset cable routing and a full carbon fork

Riders seeking performance and value, combining an upgraded gravel groupset, lightweight construction and versatile capability at an accessible price
